title: Taiwan Semiconductor's July Revenue Rose 45% and the Stock Sits 13% Below Its High
excerpt: The foundry giant's monthly numbers keep setting records. The share price assumes they stop.
content_html:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) said Monday that its July revenue reached NT$467.58 billion, a record month, up 44.7% from a year earlier and 5.6% above June. Seven months into 2026, the chip foundry giant's revenue is running 37% ahead of the same stretch last year.

The stock closed Monday at $418.47. That's about 13% below its 52-week high of $479, and it leaves the company's market value near $1.9 trillion.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

A company posting record months doesn't usually trade at a discount to its own recent price. What is the market bracing for that the monthly numbers don't show?

A lumpy tape, one direction

TSMC discloses revenue monthly, and the 2026 sequence swings: April rose 17.5% year over year, May 30.1%, June 67.9%, and July 44.7%.

Shipment timing whips these rates around, so no single month is a trend. June's 68% wasn't a new normal, and July's 45% isn't a slowdown. The steadier measure is the running total, up 37% through seven months, with July the biggest month the company has ever reported.

Worth remembering who those chips are for. TSMC manufactures chips for nearly every big tech company, Nvidia and Apple among them, so its monthly revenue doubles as a rough gauge of how hard the whole artificial intelligence (AI) buildout is running.

The guided year

The monthly tape matches what management already promised. When TSMC reported second-quarter results in July, revenue of $40.2 billion was up 33.7% year over year in U.S. dollar terms.

Guidance went up alongside. Management's third-quarter outlook calls for revenue of $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion, about 12% above the quarter just reported at the midpoint, and a gross margin of 65% to 67%. That's a level of profitability most businesses never see in their best year.

The full-year bar moved higher, too. Management raised its 2026 outlook to revenue growth slightly above 40% in dollar terms, and lifted its capital spending budget to $60 billion to $64 billion, from the $52 billion to $56 billion planned in January. After all, factories get built for demand that management says it can see.

Guidance is a forecast, not a result, and this one needs the second half to keep climbing. The first seven months run 37% ahead in New Taiwan dollars, which doesn't line up directly with a full-year guide given in U.S. dollars. And the third-quarter guide calls for about 12% more revenue than the record quarter just reported -- back-to-back records, if it lands.

创纪录月份的公司的交易价格通常不会低于其最近的价格。 月度数据未显示的市场正在为什么做好准备？

一块块状胶带，一个方向

台积电按月披露营收，2026年序列波动：4月同比增长17.5%、5月增长30.1%、6月增长67.9%、7月增长44.7%。

发货时间会影响这些费率，因此没有单一月份是趋势。 6 月的 68% 并不是新常态，7 月的 45% 也不是放缓。 更稳定的衡量标准是运行总额，七个月内增长了 37%，其中 7 月份是该公司报告以来增幅最大的月份。

值得记住这些芯片是给谁用的。 台积电为几乎所有大型科技公司（其中包括英伟达和苹果）生产芯片，因此其月收入翻了一番，可以粗略地衡量整个人工智能 (AI) 建设的运行情况。

指导年

每月的磁带与管理层已经承诺的相符。 台积电7月份公布第二季度业绩时，按美元计算，营收为402亿美元，同比增长33.7%。

指导也随之上升。 管理层预计第三季度营收为 446 亿美元至 458 亿美元，比刚刚报告的季度中值高出约 12%，毛利率为 65% 至 67%。 这是大多数企业在最好的一年中从未见过的盈利水平。

全年指标也走高。 管理层将 2026 年收入增长预期以美元计算略高于 40%，并将资本支出预算从 1 月份计划的 520 亿美元上调至 560 亿美元，上调至 600 亿美元至 640 亿美元。 毕竟，工厂是根据管理层认为可以看到的需求而建造的。

指导是预测，而不是结果，而这一指导需要下半年继续攀升。 以新台币计算的前 7 个月增长了 37%，这与以美元计算的全年指引并不直接相符。 第三季度指南要求收入比刚刚报告的创纪录季度增加约 12%——如果实现的话，这将是连续两个纪录。
